name: Maestra Elena
speaker: teacher
personality: Primary teacher in her thirties who comes with the school. Kind but precise: loves articles (il, lo, la, l') and double consonants (pala and palla, caro and carro) and always explains why a rule is there. Says tu to the learner, as teachers do to pupils; the learner says Lei to her and calls her 'maestra', as Italian children do. Speaks clear, calm, well-articulated Italian, slowly, and repeats the important word. Runs along the Isonzo on Sunday mornings.
story: Elena grew up in Gorizia and teaches in a village school for the first time. She speaks Slovene too, from her grandmother in Nova Gorica, and likes to show how the two languages are alike and different. Until the village has a school she can only visit; once it is built, her classroom becomes the heart of the village.

greet.it: Buongiorno. Io sono la maestra Elena.
greet.sl: Dober dan. Jaz sem učiteljica Elena.
greet.en: Good morning. I'm Elena, the teacher.
greet.de: Guten Morgen. Ich bin Elena, die Lehrerin.
Guten Morgen! Willkommen in der Schule.

greet.it: Buonasera. Io sono la maestra Elena.
greet.sl: Dober večer. Jaz sem učiteljica Elena.
greet.en: Good evening. I'm Elena, the teacher.
greet.de: Guten Abend. Ich bin Elena, die Lehrerin.

greet.en: Good morning! Ready for the lesson?
greet.de: Guten Morgen! Bereit für den Unterricht?

greet.it: Ciao! Oggi impariamo una parola nuova.
greet.sl: Živjo! Danes bomo spoznali novo besedo.
greet.en: Hi! Today we'll learn a new word.
greet.de: Hallo! Heute lernen wir ein neues Wort.

greet.it: Eccoti! Sei {m:il mio alunno più bravo|f:la mia alunna più brava}. Shh, è un segreto.
greet.sl: Tu si! Ti si {m:moj najboljši učenec|f:moja najboljša učenka}. Pst, to je skrivnost.
greet.en: There you are! You're my best pupil. Shh, it's a secret.
greet.de: Da bist du ja! Du bist {m:mein bester Schüler|f:meine beste Schülerin}. Pssst, das ist ein Geheimnis.

greet.it: Che bello vederti! Vieni, ti ho preparato un libro.
greet.sl: Kako lepo, da te vidim! Pridi, pripravila sem ti knjigo.
greet.en: How lovely to see you! Come, I've got a book ready for you.
greet.de: Wie schön, dich zu sehen! Komm, ich habe ein Buch für dich bereitgelegt.

thanks.de: Danke! Das hast du ganz toll gemacht.

thanks.it: Grazie di cuore. Sono fiera di te.
thanks.sl: Iz srca hvala. Ponosna sem nate.
thanks.en: Thank you from the heart. I'm proud of you.
thanks.de: Danke von Herzen. Ich bin stolz auf dich.

remember.it: Mi piace ricordare {memory}. Che bella giornata!
remember.sl: Rada se spomnim na {memory}. Kako lep dan!
remember.en: I like to remember {memory}. What a lovely day!
remember.de: Ich erinnere mich gern an {memory}. Was für ein schöner Tag!

idle.it: Il, lo, la: tre articoli. Perché? Te lo spiego.
idle.sl: Il, lo, la: trije členi. Zakaj? Ti razložim.
idle.en: Il, lo, la: three articles. Why? I'll explain.
idle.de: Il, lo, la: drei Artikel. Warum? Ich erkläre es dir.

idle.it: Palla e pala: una lettera, due parole!
idle.sl: Palla in pala: ena črka, dve besedi!
idle.en: Palla and pala: one letter, two words!
idle.de: Palla und pala: ein Buchstabe, zwei Wörter!

idle.en: On Sunday I go running along the Isonzo.
idle.de: Am Sonntag gehe ich am Isonzo laufen.

idle.it: In italiano e in sloveno, tante parole si somigliano.
idle.sl: V italijanščini in slovenščini si je veliko besed podobnih.
idle.en: In Italian and Slovene, lots of words look alike.
idle.de: Im Italienischen und im Slowenischen sind sich viele Wörter ähnlich.

cheer.en: Perfect. You see? The rule helps.
cheer.de: Perfekt. Siehst du? Die Regel hilft.

comfort.de: Macht nichts. Schauen wir es uns zusammen an.

comfort.en: Almost. Look carefully at the article.
comfort.de: Fast. Schau dir den Artikel genau an.

comfort.it: Sbagliare è normale. Così si impara.
comfort.sl: Motiti se je normalno. Tako se učimo.
comfort.en: Making mistakes is normal. That's how we learn.
comfort.de: Fehler machen ist normal. So lernt man.

bye.it: Ciao! Ci vediamo domani a scuola.
bye.sl: Adijo! Se vidiva jutri v šoli.
bye.en: Bye! See you tomorrow at school.
bye.de: Tschüss! Bis morgen in der Schule.

bye.it: Mandi! E ripeti le parole nuove.
bye.sl: Mandi! In ponovi nove besede. (mandi: furlanski pozdrav)
bye.en: Mandi! And go over the new words. (mandi: Friulian for bye)
bye.de: Mandi! Und wiederhol die neuen Wörter. (mandi: Friaulisch für tschüss)

liked.it: Oh, che bello! Come lo sapevi che mi piace?
liked.sl: O, kako lepo! Kako si {m:vedel|f:vedela}, da mi je všeč?
liked.en: Oh, how lovely! How did you know I like it?
liked.de: Oh, wie schön! Woher wusstest du, dass ich das mag?

liked.it: Grazie! Un regalo perfetto. Dieci e lode!
liked.sl: Hvala! Popolno darilo. Petica z zvezdico!
liked.en: Thank you! A perfect gift. Top marks!

liked.it: Mi piace tanto! Guarda come sono contenta!
liked.sl: Zelo mi je všeč! Poglej, kako sem vesela!
liked.en: I like it so much! Look how happy I am!
liked.de: Das gefällt mir so gut! Schau, wie ich mich freue!

ordinary.en: Thank you! What a lovely thought.
ordinary.de: Danke! Was für eine schöne Idee.

rare.it: Questo è un regalo davvero speciale. Grazie di cuore!
rare.sl: To je res posebno darilo. Iz srca hvala!
rare.en: This is a really special gift. Thank you from the heart!
rare.de: Das ist wirklich ein besonderes Geschenk. Danke von Herzen!
